name: Sherd: Square Fragment from the Wall of a Circular Vessel
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；first quarter 12th century；Probably Ru ware: light gray stoneware body with pale bluish green glaze, the interior glaze with white to buff cloudiness due either to under firing or to burial (in the waste heap at the kiln site). Probably from the Ru kilns, Henan province
